summary: Independently re-verified Phase 4 (logic/param reconciliation) + Phase 5 (Windows deployment artifacts) for MomentumX. All 41 backend pytest tests pass (16 regression exit-logic + 25 security/trading from prior pass). Confirmed via curl: GET /api/auto-trader/status returns strategy.daily_max_loss_pct=1.0, position_size_pct=10.0, profit_target_pct=2.0, stop_loss_pct=1.0, and entry_conditions.require_micro_pullback=true - exactly as required. Confirmed the previously-broken POST /api/auto-trader/settings endpoint is FIXED: {"require_bull_flag": true} now returns 200 with correct current_settings (pullback_min_candles/pullback_max_candles/require_micro_pullback present, no AttributeError/500), and restoring defaults also works. Code inspection of auto_trader_service.py confirms check_micro_pullback(bars) is called and gates entry (returns None when require_micro_pullback=True and pullback invalid) BEFORE volume/MACD/SMA checks (lines 518-521, ahead of 523-547). Code inspection of alpaca_service.py confirms SLIPPAGE_BUFFER=0.03 and MAX_SPREAD_PCT=8.0 guard that raises before computing limit price (lines 91-103) - exactly matching spec. py_compile passes for all 3 touched files. Frontend Settings page screenshot confirms the RECONCILED strategy card text (10% position sizing, +2% profit target, -1% trailing stop, -1% daily max loss hard kill switch, Entries 7-11 AM/manage until 3:30PM EST) with NO stale 5%/10%/5%/10% values anywhere on the page. Full smoke test of all 7 pages (/  scanner, trading, history, missed, settings, demo) via Playwright - no React crashes, no error elements rendered; console shows only expected 500s for /api/account /positions/orders (Alpaca not configured - correct by design). Re-verified the previously-fixed logout button: navbar logout icon is now reachable regardless of account-fetch failure, clicking it clears localStorage token and re-shows the token gate - confirms prior HIGH bug fix holds. Regression spot-checks: GET /api/settings correctly masks/omits Alpaca keys (has_api_key=false), GET /api/settings without auth returns 401 'Missing Authorization header'. Deployment artifacts (Phase 5) all exist and are well-formed: deploy/windows/README.md, start.bat, install_nssm_service.ps1, uninstall_nssm_service.ps1, backend/.env.example, frontend/.env.example - root README.md links correctly to deploy/windows/README.md. Did not execute Windows scripts (correct per review scope - Linux env).

alpaca_service.place_market_order's spread guard correctly short-circuits (raises) before computing limit_price, so a too-wide spread can never reach the order submission call - good defensive ordering.

Settings.js reconciled text was verified pixel-for-pixel against the review's required strings via Playwright DOM text extraction - all 5 required phrases present, 0 stale '5%' occurrences found.
